label: Takeaway
detail: Cleary set a program record with 31 wins and finished 4th in the WHAC, its highest finish. It won its first WHAC Tournament games and reached the semifinals. Going by class and known moves, 31% of 2026 plate appearances and 35% of innings can return, because most of the regular lineup were listed seniors. Hughes returns, Parris is out for the season, and Davis, Demko, Dye and Hutchinson are gone. Cleary has not posted a 2027 roster.

label: Method
detail: Back means a 2026 Fr., So. or Jr. on Cleary's roster, plus Hughes. Out means listed seniors, the listed graduate student, players now on the 2027 staff page, and players known to be gone or out for the season. A senior can still have eligibility left, so this is a floor to check, not a final count.

label: Season
detail: 31 wins and 18 WHAC wins are both program records, 8 more wins than in 2025. Cleary was picked 6th in the WHAC preseason poll. Cleary's coach bio counts 23 team or individual records broken, including runs scored (400) and team batting average (.320).

label: WHAC Tournament
detail: Rockford: beat Aquinas 5-2 and Cornerstone 14-4, then lost to Madonna 8-6 after leading 6-3 in the 8th, and lost to Indiana Tech 13-2 after a 10-run 8th inning.

label: Discipline at the plate
detail: Cleary struck out in 14.1% of plate appearances, 1st in the WHAC and 17th in the NAIA, and walked in 13.4%, 2nd in the WHAC. Hitters were also hit by 73 pitches.

label: Brendan Seman
detail: Seman hit .395 with 77 hits, 27 extra-base hits and a 1.085 OPS, and went 7-1 with a 2.11 ERA and 69 strikeouts in 64 innings. He started all 52 games.

label: Free passes and strikeouts
detail: The staff struck out 8.53 per nine, 2nd in the WHAC and 41st in the NAIA. It allowed 7.29 walks and hit batters per nine, 6th in the WHAC and 110th in the NAIA.

label: Power
detail: 21 homers ranked 7th in the WHAC and 146th in the NAIA per game. The team still slugged .453, with 94 doubles and 26 triples. Seman had 8 triples and Kempainen 6.

label: League play
detail: Seman hit .425 against WHAC teams. Parinello hit .414 with a 1.241 OPS against WHAC teams. Wesley hit .402 with a 1.065 OPS and can return by class.

label: Fielding
detail: Team fielding was .968, 1st in the WHAC, with 52 errors in 52 games. Opponents went 75-for-88 stealing.

label: Late innings
detail: Lucier had 4 of the 5 saves and a 5.14 ERA in 16 relief outings. The staff allowed 34 runs in the 7th and 23 in the 8th.

label: Catcher
detail: VanderHaar made 33 starts there and hit .269. Cambron hit .412 in 34 at-bats as a freshman. Parinello, a listed senior, made most of the other starts.

label: First base
detail: Rose, a listed senior, made most of the starts. Marsee, a listed junior, had 12 at-bats and one start.

label: Middle infield
detail: Boone at second and Vincent at short started nearly every game. Boone is a listed senior and Vincent is on the 2027 staff page. Bollini made 2 starts at short, and Gates had one at second.

label: Third base
detail: Mackay, a listed senior, started there most of the year with a .943 OPS. Bollini made 3 starts there.

label: Outfield
detail: Hughes returns after 45 starts in center. Wesley made 20 starts in left and can return by class. Kempainen and Seman are listed as a grad student and a senior. Miller and Simunic each made one start in the outfield, and Hutchinson is gone.

label: Designated hitter
detail: Wesley (16) and Seman (12) made most of the starts at DH. Cambron made 3.

label: Rotation
detail: Montilla (8 starts) and Noseworthy (4) can return by class. Parris (9) is out for the season and Davis (2) is gone. Seman (11), Lieng (10) and Fay (6) made 27 of the 52 starts.

label: Bullpen
detail: Amico, Bloink and Roberts made 42 relief outings between them and can return by class. Davis and Dye are gone, and so is Demko. Lucier and Green had all 5 saves and are listed seniors.

label: Ryan Lieng, RHP
detail: Listed as a graduate assistant on the 2026-27 staff page.

detail: Listed as a graduate assistant on the 2026-27 staff page.

detail: Returning in 2027.

detail: Out for the 2027 season.

detail: Gone for 2027.

label: Incoming players
detail: None verified from public sources. The 2026-27 roster page has no players yet.

label: Drew Maki, head coach
detail: 120-122 over five seasons, including 31-21 in 2026. Came from Northern Illinois, where he was pitching coach and recruiting coordinator.

label: Nick Hoogerhyde, associate head coach
detail: Also recruiting coordinator.

label: Assistant coaches
detail: Brian Martin (new on the 2027 page), Colton Fountain and Keegan Beckstrom.

label: Graduate assistants
detail: Gavin Kempainen, Ryan Lieng and Austin Vincent. Nic Olson and Chris Hawkins are on the 2026 page but not the 2027 page.

label: Brendan Seman
detail: First-team All-WHAC, the first Cleary player to do it twice; Gold Glove.

label: Joey Parinello
detail: Second-team All-WHAC.

label: Parker Davis
detail: Champions of Character team.

label: Program
detail: Record 31 wins and 18 WHAC wins; highest WHAC finish; first WHAC Tournament wins.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 33 of 49 list a Michigan hometown. Macomb County has the most with 13, then Oakland (5). St. Clair, Ingham, Livingston and Wayne have 2 each.

label: How players arrive
detail: 31 of 49 came straight from high school, 10 from a community college and 8 from another four-year school.

label: Ontario
detail: 8 players list an Ontario hometown, including Mackay and Torresan, who came through Niagara.

label: Transfers in the lineup
detail: Seman (St. Clair County CC), Parinello (St. Clair County CC), Mackay (Niagara), Kempainen (Northwood), Torresan (Niagara), Boone (Ancilla), Rose (Antelope Valley) and Vincent (Georgetown) all arrived as transfers.

label: No 2027 roster posted
detail: Cleary's 2026-27 roster page has no players yet.

label: Senior does not mean gone
detail: Known moves are listed on the 2027 outlook tab. Other listed seniors and the listed grad student stay unconfirmed until a roster posts. Players listed as able to return by class are also unconfirmed.

label: Commits are third-party listings
detail: Prep Baseball Report's Michigan commitments list shows 5 from the class of 2026: Doddy, Hurliman, Jelley Reid, Kozovski and Schertzer. An earlier note here said it listed none, which was wrong. It doesn't confirm enrollment.

label: 2027 schedule is only partly posted
detail: Cleary's schedule lists 6 games so far.

label: Pitcher decisions are incomplete by game
detail: Many 2026 box scores list no win or loss beside a pitcher. Season totals here are Cleary's published ones. The outing log marks Decision as partial, and filtered views hide wins and losses.

label: Small gaps against published stats
detail: Seman is published with 13 pitching appearances, and box scores show 11 with matching innings. Seman is published with 6 hit-by-pitches and play-by-play shows 5, because one Mar 8 line credits Lucier. Player lines total 1,562 at-bats and 276 strikeouts against team totals of 1,564 and 278. In the second Feb 17 Mount Vernon Nazarene game, the box gives Mackay 2 strikeouts and Parris 0, and play-by-play gives them 1 each.

label: Starts are counted, not published
detail: Cleary's stats don't publish games started for hitters. I took each game's first nine batters from the play-by-play, using all substitution lines to find who held each slot, with the position from the box score.

label: Forfeit and suspended games
detail: Cleary's schedule marks the first Mar 22 game with Rochester Christian as a forfeit because Rochester Christian used an ineligible player. Cleary won it 7-2 on the field, so the listed and played results agree. Feb 20 at IU Columbus is marked suspended and counted as listed.

label: Award release ran before the tournament
detail: The Apr 28 award release has Seman at .403 with 73 hits. The final stats are .395 with 77.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The game log adds to 31-21, 400 runs scored and 285 allowed, and to 18-10 in WHAC games. Line scores match those run totals.

label: Roster gaps
detail: The roster page also lists Connor Zaborny with no position, class or hometown, so he is left out. Jackson Heimbecker has no number.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from Cleary's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth.

label: Site access
detail: Cleary's clearycougars.com address refused my browser, so I read the same pages at its cleary.prestosports.com address and the NAIA stats site.

label: Source conflicts
detail: Maki's bio table shows 119-120, and Cleary's schedule pages total 120-122, which is what this page uses. The stats page lists Demko and Dye as left-handed pitchers who throw right. 9 players have no bats or throws listed. Four box scores list nearly every count as 0-0, so those games are left out of the count and pitch stats.

label: League data source
detail: Team comparisons come from the NAIA stats site, the same table used on the Madonna side.

label: Game-by-game totals checked
detail: Box scores and play-by-play add up to every hitter's published at-bats, hits, walks, strikeouts, RBI, runs, doubles, triples, homers and steals. Pitcher innings, hits, runs, earned runs, walks, strikeouts and homers also match.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from every 2026 box score, using players listed Fr., So. or Jr. plus Hughes, and leaving out players known to be gone or out. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Only Wesley, Hughes and VanderHaar were regular starters, and Open spots had a start or fewer at that position.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 52 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at DH (Wesley, 16) or left (Kempainen, 21), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: Cleary used 32 different lineups in 52 games. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles based on class and known moves. Seman, Lieng, Fay, Parris and Davis made 38 of the 52 starts, so those starts are open. Amico and Murray are in the rotation because they are the only other returners with a 2026 start, one each.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings. GS and Relief are published totals where listed, and box scores otherwise.

label: Maps
detail: Each of the 49 players with a listed hometown is plotted at that hometown. The hot zone is a density estimate over those towns, so color shows concentration, not exact locations.

label: League
detail: Cleary ranked 3rd in the WHAC in batting average and on-base, 4th in OPS and 1st in avoiding strikeouts. On the mound it ranked 2nd in strikeouts per nine, 5th in ERA and 6th in walks and hit batters per nine.

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows Cleary's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season. Wins and losses are hidden under a filter, since box scores don't list every decision.

label: D1Baseball season preview
detail: Conference previews plus a Top 25 table with rank, last record and last final rank.
extra: Overview: last season and preseason context up front

label: Baseball America newcomer classes
detail: Each team lists transfers and high school recruits by tier, then explains fit.
extra: Recruiting tab: newcomers by route, with fit notes

label: Black College Nines team previews
detail: Returning starters, starting pitching, relievers and newcomers with prior school, then a short outlook.

label: College football returning production
detail: A weighted share of last year's production that returns, with transfers added in.
extra: Returning share bars, unweighted for now

label: EvanMiya college basketball
detail: Share of minutes from returners. Returner-reliant teams beat expectations far more often than newcomer-reliant ones.
extra: Plate appearances and innings as the continuity measure

label: TeamRankings college basketball
detail: Projects from prior ratings, returning production, recruits, transfers and coaching changes.
extra: Staff tab: coaching change treated as an input

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Runs by inning
detail: Cleary scored 139 of its 400 runs in the 4th and 5th. It scored 62 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: Runs allowed
detail: Opponents scored most in the 6th, 44 runs, then 41 in the 4th.

label: Steals
detail: 66 of 75 steals were of second, 8 of third and 1 of home. Kempainen stole 20; Hughes and Wesley stole 13 each. Cleary was caught 12 times.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 52 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies. That gives Cleary's hitters 390 and 424, against 385 and 419 published as a team, and scorers can classify a few plays differently.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Wesley has 1.19 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (100 or more plate appearances), and Mackay has 0.58.

label: How long arms go
detail: Seman averages 5.8 innings a start, Lieng 3.9 and Parris 4.9. Lucier 1.3 and Bloink 1.4 per relief outing.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Fay has 2.16 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and Lieng has 0.52.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: VanderHaar swings at 45% of first pitches, the most among regulars (100 or more plate appearances), on 103 of 133 plate appearances with pitch data. Vincent swings at 15%, on 122 of 170.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Seman whiffs on 12% of swings, the fewest among regulars, and Hughes on 24%. On the mound, Montilla gets a whiff on 29% and Lucier on 14%.

label: Direction
detail: Mackay pulls 58% of his batted balls, the most among regulars, on 121 with a direction. Hughes pulls 39%, on 79.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Seman averages 84 pitches a start and reached 110. Noseworthy averages 53. Averages use only outings with a listed count.

label: Checked against NAIA stats
detail: I compared every Cleary game with a gap against NAIA stats, which posts the same box scores as the WHAC site. Apr 18 and May 1 each show counts on only two plate appearances, so those games stay out of the pitch stats, and the rest have no pitch data there. Aquinas's site added Seman's Apr 23 win. Fourteen games still list no decision for the team's result.

label: Player matchups
detail: Hits, walks and strikeouts tie to the box score for 165 of 166 opposing pitching lines and 757 of 759 opposing hitter lines. Feb 20 vs IU Columbus: the box credits Riley Mertl with 2 strikeouts the play-by-play doesn't show, so those 2 plate appearances are missing. Mar 14 vs Madonna, game 2: play-by-play names Nathan Carr and the box line says Camden Youngquist, so that at-bat shows Carr, as Madonna's game log does. Apr 22 vs Grace Christian, game 2: Moises Lerma shows 1 more strikeout and Dale Westphal 1 fewer hit than the box. Those rows follow the play-by-play.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 1,153 of Cleary's 1,562 at-bats (74%): 90% of balls in play, 74% of hits (372 of 500) and 99% of everything else (781 of 786). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots. One Feb 17 strikeout logged to Parris belongs to Gates by the box score, and I corrected it.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.
